title: Beyond the Lower-Star Filtration: Alternative Filtration Methods for Persistent Homology
abstract: arXiv:2611.08833v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the lower-star filtration (LSF), simplices are assigned filtration values according to the maximum-vertex rule, with each simplex entering the filtration when its highest-valued vertex appears. A limitation of this construction is that some higher-dimensional simplices may enter simultaneously with their boundary faces, causing certain topological features to be filled immediately upon formation and thus not appear in the resulting persistence diagram. To address this limitation, we propose three alternative filtration methods: the \(\varepsilon\)-lower-star filtration (ELSF), the \(L_p\) filtration (LpF), and the softmax filtration (SMF). {ELSF introduces a dimension-dependent delay to the maximum-vertex rule,} allowing higher-dimensional simplices to enter the filtration after their boundary faces, whereas {LpF and SMF use aggregation functions that depend on all vertex values rather} than solely on their maximum. translated_title: 超越下星过滤：持久同调的替代过滤方法
translated_abstract: 在下星过滤（LSF）中，单纯形根据最大顶点规则被分配过滤值，即每个单纯形在其最高值顶点出现时进入过滤。这种构造的一个局限性在于，某些高维单纯形可能与其边界面同时进入过滤，导致某些拓扑特征在形成之初就被立即填充，因而不会出现在最终的持久图中。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了三种替代过滤方法：ε-下星过滤（ELSF）、L_p过滤（LpF）和softmax过滤（SMF）。ELSF在最大顶点规则中引入了与维度相关的延迟，使高维单纯形在其边界面之后进入过滤；而LpF和SMF则使用依赖于所有顶点值而非仅仅依赖最大值的聚合函数。通过修改（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文针对下星过滤中高维单纯形与其边界面同时进入导致拓扑特征被立即填充而无法体现在持久图中的局限性，提出了ELSF、LpF和SMF三种替代过滤方法，以更完整地捕捉拓扑特征。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three alternative filtration methods (ELSF, LpF, and SMF) to overcome the limitation of lower-star filtration, where higher-dimensional simplices entering simultaneously with their boundary faces cause topological features to be filled immediately and omitted from persistence diagrams.
